svg.title: One question, four systems
svg.desc: Question 41: Why was the 1963 Sudbury and Woodbridge by-election held? GEL RAM returned the source passage: …The 1963 Sudbury and Woodbridge by-election was held in 1963 after the previous Conservative MP, John Hare was elevated to the House of Lords. The seat was held by the Conservative Party. Sudbury and Woodbridge by-election, 1963 The three models answered: Because the incumbent MP died, triggering a by‑election. / Because the sitting MP died. / The death of the sitting Member of Parliament..
